stem.text: A uniform bar of weight $200\,\text{N}$ and length $4.0\,\text{m}$ is freely hinged on a wall at one end.
The bar is horizontal and is held in equilibrium by a cable attached at a distance of $0.50\,\text{m}$ from the other end. The cable is at an angle of $35^{\circ}$ to the horizontal.

stem.alt: Horizontal bar hinged to a wall at its right end, held by a cable at an angle of 35° to the horizontal, with tension T labelled, and lengths 0.50 m and 4.0 m marked

stem.text: What is the tension $T$ in the cable?
